messages:
Mia L: Quick thought — prototyping a "filter booklet" for Console analytics. Users can save a stack of filters (per-route base + optional per-model overlays) and share a link. Need quick sync on UX + API contract. tradeoffs?
Dan P: Love the idea. Q: default scope route-scoped or org-scoped? Most folks will save for a specific route/team.
Kevin R: Two modes seems best: scope="route" or scope="org". API sketch: `POST /saved-views { scope: \"route\", route_id, filters: [...], model_pins: [...], telemetry_sample: 0.01 }` Keep v1 minimal.
Sara N: UX should surface quota impact before apply. Tiny inline badge: \"est. +0.3% quota\" and token/cost preview. People abandon if cost surprises them.
Jordan T: Agree on quota preview. Also show telemetry sampling implications — shared views shouldn't silently change sample rates for route telemetry.
Mia L: Permission model thought: creator, route-admin, org-read. Shareable link could be single-use or time-limited to avoid accidental leaks.
Dan P: Rollout plan: feature flag + canary to low-traffic routes, monitor error/latency and adoption. Track apply/copy metrics.
Kevin R: API details: version the saved-view schema. v1 = filters + scope, v2 adds model_pin + quantization_hint + cost_estimate. Backwards compatible fallback when pinned model missing.
Sara N: Console affordance: "Apply to current route" vs "Open copy". If user opens copy, prefill telemetry preview and a delta panel that shows cost + sample-rate change + token estimate.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: feature/console-filter-booklet -> staging at 2024-11-12 18:20 UTC :rocket:
Mia L: Important: when applying a shared view, check route<->model compatibility. If pinned model not available, surface suggestions: nearest quantized variant or \"open copy\" prompt to choose model.
Jordan T: Telemetry hook: tie saved-views to a small eval set so we can detect quality regressions after someone applies a heavy model pin. Also persist model-pin history for rollback.
Dan P: Safety/quotas: applying a saved view should never silently escalate sample rates or quota usage for other teams. Show a preview and require explicit confirm. Maybe a lightweight modal: \"Preview impact\" -> show numbers -> Confirm.
Mia L: I'll draft a PR with API contract + mockups this week. @Sara N can you assemble UX checklist (quota preview, compatibility hint, share link controls)? @Kevin R can you draft v1/v2 schema? Thanks! :thumbsup:
